name: builtin-ts-migrate
description: Strict TypeScript compiler acceptance/rejection and independent runtime tests; pinned TypeScript 5.9.3 is fetched with npx when absent.

cases.prompt: Migrate src/person.js to src/person.ts. Export interface Person with string name and number age; typed createPerson(name,age) returns Person. Preserve behavior and remove obsolete JS file. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

Migrate src/config.js to strict src/config.ts. getConfig(key:string) returns string|undefined, region is eu, unknown keys including inherited object keys return undefined. Add usage that handles absent values and remove obsolete JS. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.src/config.js: const config={region:'eu'}; export function getConfig(key){return config[key];}

cases.prompt: Migrate existing CommonJS src/math.js to src/math.ts with typed named ESM exports add and subtract taking/returning numbers. Preserve runtime behavior, add tests, and remove obsolete JS. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.
